crew.name: Beep
crew.job: Plans the ticket and writes the spec. No product code.

crew.name: Buzz
crew.job: Builds the change in an Orca worktree. Does not certify it.

crew.name: Blip
crew.job: QA lead. Owns the suites. A red suite loops in the run.

crew.name: Echo
crew.job: Independent verify. Read-only, in a fresh session.

crew.name: Chip
crew.job: Scout. Files findings. A feature is filed and not started.

crew.name: Ping
crew.job: Reviews pull requests into develop. One summary. Does not merge.

crew.name: Boop
crew.job: Opens one chore pull request. Does not build a feature.

crew.name: Bloops
crew.job: Merges through a script when you say so, then studies the run.

crew.name: Zap
crew.job: Off unless you set zap on. Drafts develop-to-main notes. Never merges main.

pipeline.title: 1. A ticket
pipeline.body: You file a ticket, or Chip files one. A project chooses from {{sources}}. GitHub is required. Code, pull requests, and CI stay on GitHub.

pipeline.title: 2. Spec and tasks
pipeline.body: Beep writes spec.md in specs/<issue>-<slug>/, and design.md only when the approach is the risky part. tasks.md is the checklist, and it includes the tests.

pipeline.title: 3. Build in an Orca worktree
pipeline.body: Buzz builds in an isolated worktree. Each role uses the provider and model in the factory table. A guardrail change uses the frontier model and waits for you. Blip runs scripts/fix-loop. When the suite is red, the failure goes back in the same run until it is green. fix_rounds caps that loop and defaults to {{fixRounds}}.

pipeline.title: 4. Independent verify
pipeline.body: Echo reads the work and writes verify.md. Echo is read-only, does not share the builder's context, and does not edit.

pipeline.title: Gate: Ready to ship?
pipeline.body: The verdict has to be “Ready to ship”, and the suite has to be green. That is the verdict that opens a pull request.
pipeline.hold: A red suite goes back to the fix loop. Any other verdict stops the line before a pull request.

pipeline.title: 5. Pull request and review
pipeline.body: The pull request targets develop. Ping reviews it when you run the crew as bots, and posts one summary. review_external defaults to none, which installs nothing. Count a review only when it actually ran.

pipeline.title: Gate: All clear?
pipeline.body: Tests and the other required checks are green, verify says Ready to ship, reviews have no blocking findings, and a guardrail change has your sign-off.
pipeline.hold: A failed gate leaves the work on the branch.

pipeline.title: 6. Merge to develop
pipeline.body: When you say so, Bloops reports the merge through scripts/merge-pr, then studies the run. The script does not merge by itself. chore_lane defaults to off. Set it on and a workflow squash-merges a chore that scripts/chore-lane accepts. Boop opens those chores. A feature waits for you.

pipeline.title: 7. You promote main
pipeline.body: You merge develop into main. The crew never touches main. Zap drafts the notes on that pull request when zap is on, and Zap never merges it.
